## Why

Jon's ui role reported this as tool feedback on ork run ork-20261120-133801-8a30 (item S449). A report with two `Question:` blocks and two `Decision key:` lines in `## Owner needed` was refused for shape. The prompts show one block and one key but never say that is the limit.

The shape check allows one question block and one key in `## Owner needed`:
- A second `Question:` block fails in `ownerBlockLines` with "Options: comes after Recommend:" (`internal/engine/kinds.go:269-270`).
- A second `Decision key:` line fails at `internal/engine/report.go:272-276`.

Jon decided (adj 682, session 8d711f67, 2026-11-28, "Add all eight") that the sentence goes in eight prompts: ui, architect, gate, reviewer, spec-check, implementer, lead and part. These are exactly the eight prompts that carry the "From `Question:` onward" rule today. spec-draft stays out because its own parser allows one block per decision.
